topography.project_purpose: Leveraged Farming. Structurally: 205 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 6 ERC20 tokens, 31 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on solmate.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 51 common project-authored base contract(s) (rebalancer, abstractbase, guardian). Dominant framework: solmate.
